svg.title: Roland V-STAGE 88 connections
svg.desc: Connection inventory. Arrows indicate signal direction relative to the instrument. Locations identify hardware faces; the diagram is not a socket placement drawing. Physical control sections are listed below.
svg.metadata: Symbol vocabulary: NYU ABILITY Project / IDM SynthAccess; https://github.com/IDMNYU/synthaccess/tree/ee1ef12cec3a3fb6be59a7861f7df8848be2dafe/tactileSynthGuides. Original schematic geometry; physical controls do not imply MIDI mappings.
svg.text: Roland V-STAGE 88 / CONNECTIONS
Arrows are relative to the device. Locations name the hardware face; sockets are grouped by function.
INPUTS
OUTPUTS
DATA / POWER / CONTROLS
PHYSICAL CONTROLS / see interface.svg for labelled positions
Controllers: Pitch bend, Modulation, Assignable / Rotary Brake, Assignable / Rotary Speed
Master volume / Rotary: Master volume, On/Off, Brake, Speed
Organ: Level / Pan, On/Off, Split Left, Split Right, Octave Down, Octave Up, H-Bar Manual
Organ tone / Drive: Tone Select / Push, Drive, Overdrive On/Off / Type
Organ vibrato / Chorus: Type, On/Off
Organ percussion: Volume, Decay, Harmonic, On/Off, Pedal / Organ Split, Lower / Organ Split, Upper
Organ harmonic bars: 16 ft, 5 1/3 ft, 8 ft, 4 ft, 2 2/3 ft, 2 ft, 1 3/5 ft, 1 1/3 ft, 1 ft
Acoustic piano: Level / Pan, On/Off, Split Left, Split Right, Octave Down, Octave Up, Key Touch Select, Tone Select / Push, Piano Designer, Brightness, Stereo Width
Scene display: Display
Scene functions: Write, Menu / Panel Lock, Assign / DAW Ctrl, Tap Tempo, Transpose, Split Point / Reset
Scene selection / Navigation: Scene Select / Ex Scene, Scene Chain, Shift, Exit, Left, Right, Dec, Inc, Select / Push Enter, 1 / A, 2 / B, 3 / C, 4 / D, 5 / E, 6 / F, 7 / G, 8 / H
Electric piano: Level / Pan, On/Off, Split Left, Split Right, Octave Down, Octave Up, Key Touch Select, Tone Select / Push, Detune, Sound Lift, MFX Ctrl 1, MFX Ctrl 2, MFX Ctrl 3, MFX On/Off / Type,
Tremolo Depth, Tremolo Rate, Tempo Sync, Tremolo On/Off / Type, Amp Drive, Amp Treble, Amp Bass, Amp On/Off / Type
Synthesizer A/B: Level / Pan, On/Off, Split Left, Split Right, Octave Down, Octave Up, Part Select / Dual, Tone Select / Push, Attack, Release, Cutoff, MFX Ctrl 1, MFX Ctrl 2, MFX On/Off
Total effects MFX: Ctrl 1, Ctrl 2, Send, On/Off / Type
Total effects delay: Level, Time, Feedback, Send, On/Off / Tempo Sync
Total effects reverb: Level, Time, Send, On/Off / Type
Master EQ / Compressor: High, Mid, Low, Mid Freq, EQ On/Off, Comp Control / Push On
Mic in: Level, On/Off
